name: Paradox ~Hakai no Rasen~
source:
Main character lost his parents early and now lives with his sister. He starts to see his sister as a woman, and to extinguish this feeling he starts to attack and insult other girls. Where will that bring him? Can a broken heart be cured?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角早年失去了父母，现在和妹妹住在一起。他开始将他的妹妹视为女性，为了消除这种感觉，他开始攻击和侮辱其他女孩。那会把他带到哪里？破碎的心可以治愈吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
